NotificationChannelSettings.description: One channel of the `notifications` kind. `type` decides the members it takes, and `x-sparkles-kinds` lists the types each member applies to. A credential is always named by a secret reference and never held inline.

host.description: The SMTP server's host name or IP address. It passes the outbound policy's host check.
host.title: Host

password.description: A secret that holds the SMTP password, sent with SASL PLAIN. It needs a user name.

secret.description: The secret that holds the password.
secret.title: Password

password.title: Password

priority.title: Priority
priority.x-sparkles-unset: 4 for warnings, 5 for critical events, else 3

signingSecret.description: A secret that holds the key of the Standard Webhooks signature. Without it, requests are not signed.

secret.description: The secret that holds the signing key. A value that starts with whsec_ is decoded from Base64.
secret.title: Signing secret

signingSecret.title: Signing secret

tags.description: Tags added to the event type's own tag, at most 10 of 1 to 64 characters without commas.
tags.title: Tags

tls.description: STARTTLS on the submission port, or TLS from the first byte. A connection without TLS is refused.
tls.title: TLS

token.description: A secret that holds an ntfy access token, sent as a bearer token.

secret.description: The secret that holds the token.
secret.title: Access token

token.title: Access token

topic.description: The topic to publish to, 1 to 64 letters, digits, - and _. Anyone who guesses a topic on a public server can read it, so use a token with a reserved topic or a server of your own.
topic.title: Topic

type.description: How the channel delivers: a webhook POST, an ntfy publish or an email over SMTP.
type.title: Type

url.description: The http or https URL the envelope is posted to. A URL that carries a user name, a password, a query or a fragment is refused, so name such a URL with the URL secret instead. A private address requires --outbound-allow-private.
url.title: URL

urlSecret.description: A secret that holds the whole URL, for a URL that carries a credential, in place of URL.

secret.description: The secret that holds the URL. Set either URL or this.
secret.title: URL secret

urlSecret.title: URL secret

username.description: The SASL PLAIN user name. It needs a password.
username.title: User name

NotificationChannelSettings.title: Channel

NotificationsSettings.description: The `notifications` kind of `/$/server/settings/notifications` and of the settings file's `server.notifications`: whether events are delivered, the channels, the routes from event types to channels, the repeat interval and the retries. The web UI builds its form from this schema.

baseUrl.description: The URL the web UI is reached at, which makes the links in notifications absolute.
baseUrl.title: Base URL

channels.description: Channels by name, at most 32. Names can contain only letters, digits and the characters _ - .
channels.title: Channels

delivery.description: The retries and timeout of each delivery.

attempts.description: Attempts of one delivery, the first included.
attempts.title: Attempts

backoffSecs.description: The wait before the second attempt, which doubles for each later one.
backoffSecs.title: Backoff

maxBackoffSecs.description: The longest wait between two attempts, at least the backoff.
maxBackoffSecs.title: Longest backoff

timeoutSecs.description: How long one attempt may take.
timeoutSecs.title: Timeout

delivery.title: Delivery

enabled.description: Deliver events to the channels the routes name. A test send works either way.
enabled.title: Enabled

repeatEvery.description: The shortest time between two notifications about one lasting condition, as a duration of at least 1m such as 12h or 1d.
repeatEvery.title: Repeat every

additionalProperties.description: The channels this route sends to.
additionalProperties.title: Channels

routes.description: The channels each event type goes to. A key is an event type, a prefix ending in .* or *, and an event goes to the union of the channels of every key that matches it. Each route is one field.
routes.title: Routes

server.description: The server's name in each notification.
server.title: Server name

NotificationsSettings.title: Notification configuration
